source_registry.claim: The ELOC resale registration statement on Form S-1 became effective October 30, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. ET.
Final prospectus for Cantor's resale of up to 5,218,935 newly issued shares under the committed equity facility.
Purchase agreement terms, issuer discretion, 97% VWAP purchase price, 4.99% ownership limit, 20% volume limit and commitment fee.
Up to 11,499,992 shares may be issued upon cash exercise of public warrants at $11.50 per share; proceeds are received only upon exercise.

eloc_facility.purchase_price_formula: 97% of applicable VWAP, subject to agreement terms and purchase conditions
eloc_facility.use_of_proceeds: General corporate purposes, including XRP acquisition and other XRP ecosystem activities, and working capital; issuer says it expects a substantial portion of any proceeds to be used to acquire additional XRP but retains broad discretion.
eloc_facility.critical_distinction: The registration becoming effective and a final prospectus being filed satisfy two stated conditions, but do not alone prove all Section 7.2 commencement conditions, a purchase notice, share issuance, settlement or cash receipt. The prospectus explicitly reports zero proceeds received under the facility as of October 30.

prospectus_internal_discrepancy.interpretation: The same October 30 prospectus retains an approximately $80.7M figure in its summary while its cover and detailed Use of Proceeds section state approximately $76.8M gross and $74.4M net using the October 29 $14.71 reference price. The $80.7M figure is arithmetically consistent with 5,218,935 × $15.46, the October 22 share price disclosed in the earlier October 23 filing. This appears to be stale summary text, but the internal inconsistency is preserved rather than silently corrected.

public_warrants.interpretation: A separate potential capital channel. The issuer receives proceeds only when holders exercise for cash. Registration alone does not create cash or establish an XRP purchase.

capital_classification.double_counting_rule: Do not add ELOC potential, warrant potential, advance-funding cash and in-kind XRP as though they were one contemporaneous cash raise or open-market XRP purchase. Keep date, instrument, settlement, use-of-proceeds and asset-form fields separate.

model_admission.reason: Primary SEC filings establish contractual capacity and a zero-proceeds as-of date, but no byte-complete SEC filing receipts, independent filing timestamp anchors, post-October-30 purchase notices, settlement confirmations or subsequent XRP acquisition receipts were archived.

next_actions: Check subsequent 8-K, 10-Q, 424B filings and issuer share-count changes for actual Cantor purchases and warrant exercises.
Reconcile transfer/custody evidence before counting any new XRP acquisition.
Preserve the $80.7M versus $76.8M internal prospectus discrepancy as a source-quality flag.
Keep ELOC, public warrants, PIK debt, historical advance funding and in-kind XRP contributions in separate capital ledgers.
